title: Whitebox sections missing domain-critical subsections for OpenSearch/RBAC enforcement
description: Phase 2 features AM-1, SD-9, SD-13, SD-14 enforce data role visibility at the OpenSearch query layer. Sections 1.6 (RBAC + VisibilityProfile) and 5 (RBAC Domain Deep Dive) contain the exact OpenSearch MUST clause format and AlertVisibilityProfile. Both are critical for Phase 2 implementors but neither was included in the Phase 2 whitebox sections.
root_cause: The whitebox section selection in Phase 3.3 filters by top-level domain match but does not check whether specific subsections within a whitebox section are required by features in the phase. RBAC enforcement spans multiple domains and its OpenSearch-specific subsection was not recognized as relevant to the Search & Discovery domain.
recommendation: In Phase 3.3, after selecting whitebox sections by domain, perform a second pass: for each feature in the phase, check if its blackbox spec references concepts (RBAC, visibility, scoping, bitmask, etc.) that map to specific whitebox subsections. Include those subsections even if the top-level section heading doesn't match the feature's domain.
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Whitebox Reference Sections
